ios.desc:
Fieldnoter turns your conversations into clear, organized text, fully on your iPhone.

Record live or import an audio or video file. Fieldnoter transcribes it on your device, labels who said what, and gives you a short summary with the key points. Your audio and transcripts stay on your iPhone. There is no cloud and no account.

What you can do:
- Record or import audio and video
- Fast, accurate on-device transcription with a choice of models
- Speaker labels so you can follow who said what
- An on-device AI summary with the key points
- Search across every recording, and group them by client or project
- Export as Text, SRT, VTT, JSON and more
- Early access: ask questions about a recording and send action items to Reminders
- Lock the app with Face ID

What you need
Fieldnoter works best on iPhone 12 and newer. Summaries via Apple Intelligence need iPhone 15 Pro or newer. On other models with 6 GB of memory or more you download a summary model once and start a summary yourself. On models with 4 GB (such as iPhone 12 and 13) Fieldnoter transcribes without summaries. On older iPhones with limited memory (XR, SE 2nd generation) the on-device models are too heavy.

Pay once. No subscription. Everything runs on your device.
